papers.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
papers.authors: Chengsong Huang, Zifeng Wang, Rujun Han, Jun Yan, Yanfei Chen, Zoey CuiZhu, Ke Jiang, Peng Xia, Han Yu, Yufan Zhuang, Yifei Ming, Jiaqi Pan, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Jiaxin Huang, Burak Gokturk, Tomas Pfister, Chen-Yu Lee
papers.institutions: Washington University in St. Louis; Google Cloud AI Research; Google Cloud; University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
papers.summary_zh: EnvHarness 把静态任务环境包装为可编程的环境 Harness，通过 Stage、Contract、Chain 等插件改变起点、约束动作/观测并串联环境。EnvRigger 将目标 Agent 视为黑盒，从成功/失败轨迹诊断短板并自动生成环境组件，使训练环境能随 Agent 能力共同演化。其高光点是复用原环境 verifier，不重写环境逻辑，降低了构建新交互环境的成本。对电商内容生态而言，它可迁移到达人治理 SOP、商品内容审核、搜索 badcase 修复等 Agent 训练环境。
papers.story_zh: 静态环境无法针对 Agent 的短板继续提供学习信号，因此需要在不破坏原验证器的前提下重塑任务难度与流程；EnvHarness 用接口层插件做环境改造，EnvRigger 再根据轨迹自动合成插件。
papers.innovation_zh: 相较直接生成新环境或只扩充任务数据，该方法把环境适配抽象成可组合插件，兼顾跨域复用与验证可靠性。创新合理且工程可行，尤其适合已有真实流程与规则的治理场景。
papers.metrics_zh: 在 SWE-bench Verified、OfficeQA、SpreadsheetBench 等任务上，学习自 EnvHarness 环境的 Agent 比原始环境训练最高提升 9.0 个点，并减少 9.8% 交互步骤。
papers.summary_en: EnvHarness wraps static environments with programmable plug-ins that reshape starts, contracts, and episode chains without modifying the original verifier. EnvRigger observes black-box trajectories, diagnoses weaknesses, and synthesizes environment components that keep producing targeted learning signals. For e-commerce governance, this maps naturally to policy-driven moderation and bad-case remediation environments.
papers.innovation_en: Instead of generating new environments, it composes verifier-preserving harness components around existing environments, which is more reusable and operationally safer.
papers.metrics_en: Agents trained with EnvHarness environments improve held-out success by up to 9.0 points and use 9.8% fewer execution steps on reported benchmarks.

papers.title: FlashPrefill V2: Block-Sparse Prefill Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
papers.authors: Qihang Fan, Huaibo Huang, Zhiying Wu, Bingning Wang, Ran He
papers.summary_zh: FlashPrefill V2 面向长上下文 LLM 的 prefill 阶段，将块稀疏注意力从原型推进到可部署系统。核心包括均值校正项降低剪枝误差、面向 Hopper GPU 的 PackGQA/warp specialization/pingpong kernel，以及对 paged KV cache 和 continuous batching 的支持。它对电商内容治理中的长文档、长视频脚本、达人历史行为摘要推理有直接的推理成本价值。
papers.story_zh: 长上下文注意力 prefill 成本过高，而旧版稀疏方法精度和工程集成不足；因此论文同时补齐精度校正、GPU kernel 和 serving 框架兼容性。
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点不只在稀疏模式，还把误差补偿和生产推理栈对齐结合起来，工程合理性很强。
papers.metrics_zh: 在 NVIDIA H20、128K context 下，BF16 相对 FlashAttention-2 加速 27.19×，FP8 加速 47.26×；相对 FA3/4-aligned dense baseline 仍有 30.49× FP8 加速。
papers.summary_en: FlashPrefill V2 makes block-sparse prefill attention production-ready with mean correction, Hopper-oriented kernels, FP8 support, paged KV cache, and continuous batching. It is valuable for long-context moderation and content-understanding workloads where inference cost dominates.
papers.innovation_en: The paper combines approximation control, kernel-level optimization, and serving integration rather than treating sparse attention as an isolated algorithm.
papers.metrics_en: It reports 27.19x BF16 and 47.26x FP8 speedups over FlashAttention-2 at 128K context on NVIDIA H20.

papers.title: Inject, Align, Recover: Staged Post-Training for Retrieval-Free Document Knowledge Internalization
papers.authors: Qian Kou, Xiaofeng Shi, Xiaosong Qiu, Hua Zhou
papers.summary_zh: IAR 研究无检索条件下如何把固定文档集合转化为模型参数知识。它分为 Inject、Align、Recover 三阶段：先把文档构造成续写、改写、指令重构等密集监督；再用 answer-only QA 对齐问答接口；最后与原始 instruction model 做模型合并以恢复通用能力。该思路适合把电商治理规则、内容政策、达人知识库内化到小模型中，以减少线上检索延迟或隐私暴露。
papers.story_zh: 单纯 QA SFT 覆盖事实稀疏，CPT 又不直接对齐问答行为且会遗忘通用能力；IAR 将知识注入、问答对齐、能力恢复拆成独立模块以平衡领域准确率和通用能力。
papers.innovation_zh: 与传统 CPT+SFT 相比，IAR 的关键差异是将文档转为结构化重构目标，并显式用模型合并恢复通用能力；思路清晰、复现门槛中等。
papers.metrics_zh: 在 Common Corpus 与 CCI、多模型家族上，IAR 在 7/8 个 dataset-model 设置中四项指标全部超过 Vanilla SFT，平均提升 3.6 个百分点 domain QA accuracy 和 12.1 个百分点通用能力均值。
papers.summary_en: IAR turns a fixed document corpus into parametric knowledge through Inject, Align, and Recover stages. It is relevant to internalizing e-commerce policies and creator-governance knowledge when retrieval latency or privacy is undesirable.
papers.innovation_en: The method separates dense document exposure, answer-interface alignment, and post-hoc capability recovery via model merging.
papers.metrics_en: It improves over Vanilla SFT on all four reported metrics in 7/8 dataset-model settings, with average gains of 3.6 pp domain QA accuracy and 12.1 pp general performance.

papers.title: PolicyGuide: From Guarding One Action to Guiding the Whole Workflow for Policy-Compliant LLM Agents
papers.authors: Seongjae Kang, Taehyung Yu, Sung Ju Hwang
papers.summary_zh: PolicyGuide 将组织策略编译成 workflow graph，在每个用户轮次边界主动验证当前会话状态，并返回下一步合规补救建议。它不是只在危险 action 前拦截，而是在流程层面引导 Agent 逐步完成身份核验、资格判断、确认等要求。该框架非常贴近达人治理、内容审核工单、处罚申诉和运营策略执行场景。
papers.story_zh: 传统 action guard 发现问题太晚，SOP agent 又把流程控制绑在特定 agent 内；PolicyGuide 用外部工作流图和持久状态，在不改 agent 的前提下持续引导并拦截流程违规。
papers.innovation_zh: 它把安全/合规从单步动作约束提升为可解释的流程图状态机，兼具 Agent 无关性和可迁移性；在电商治理 SOP 上落地可行性高。
papers.metrics_zh: 在 τ2-bench airline、retail、telecom 上，GPT-5.4 agent 的平均 PASS^4 从 0.42 提升到 0.62，telecom 从 0.19 提升到 0.61，并可迁移到 Claude Sonnet 4.6 与 Gemini 2.5 Pro。
papers.summary_en: PolicyGuide compiles policies into workflow graphs and proactively verifies the graph state at user-turn boundaries. It offers step-specific remediation and can guide content or creator-governance agents through multi-step compliance procedures.
papers.innovation_en: It moves from action-local guarding to workflow-level external guidance, making compliance state explicit and agent-agnostic.
papers.metrics_en: Mean PASS^4 rises from 0.42 to 0.62 on τ2-bench, with telecom improving from 0.19 to 0.61.

papers.title: The Embedder's Dilemma: LLMs Are Better, but at What Cost?
papers.authors: Adnan El Assadi, Niklas Muennighoff, Jinhyuk Lee
papers.institutions: Harvard University; Stanford University; Independent Researcher
papers.summary_zh: 该论文系统比较 10 个 LLM 与 26 个 embedding model 在 37 个 MTEB(LLM) 任务上的效果、成本和吞吐。结论是 LLM 与最佳 embedding 模型总体几乎持平，但成本最高可达同等质量 embedding 的 1431×，同 GPU 吞吐慢 2.5–736×。对电商内容向量化、相似聚类、召回系统而言，建议 embedding 做默认方案，LLM 仅用于推理型检索。
papers.story_zh: 业界倾向用 LLM 替代 embedding 管道，但质量提升并不稳定且成本巨大；论文通过统一 benchmark 与精确成本核算明确了何时该用 LLM、何时仍应坚持 embedding model。
papers.innovation_zh: 创新主要在评测设计和成本-质量 Pareto 分析，不是新模型结构；结论对工程选型非常实用。
papers.metrics_zh: 最佳 LLM Gemini 3.1 Pro 得分 77.6，最佳 embedding model 77.2，仅差 0.4；但前者一次 benchmark 成本 154 美元，后者约 0.11 美元。
papers.summary_en: The paper compares LLMs and embedding models on quality, cost, and throughput. It recommends embeddings as the default for similarity, classification, and clustering, reserving LLMs for reasoning-heavy retrieval.
papers.innovation_en: The main contribution is a controlled cost-aware benchmark and Pareto analysis across embedding and generative paradigms.
papers.metrics_en: Best LLM and best embedding model differ by only 0.4 points, while the LLM can cost up to 1431x more and process tokens 2.5-736x slower.

papers.title: SkillEvo: Self-Renewing Evolution Gradients from Multi-Turn Interaction Feedback
papers.authors: Qianxi Yan, Chunrong Chen, Jiuzhou Zhao, Min Zhang, Yongzhou Xu, Xiaochuan Xu
papers.summary_zh: SkillEvo 用多轮用户模拟持续暴露 skill 的隐性缺陷，并通过独立治理层修复事实退化和结构膨胀。它把评价从单轮 QA 终点分数转化为可归因、可修复的演化梯度。对治理 Agent 的策略知识维护、运营 SOP 自动迭代有参考价值。
papers.story_zh: 单轮评测只能暴露显性缺陷，多轮任务中才出现的问题会被遗漏；SkillEvo 用跟进问题和责任归因持续生成修复信号。
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点在反馈生成和治理层，但业务相关性弱于直接内容理解/达人治理论文。
papers.metrics_zh: 在 6 类云服务、9 个生产 Skills、98 个参考文件上，SkillEvo 比 self-reflection evolution 高 23.0 分，比 single-turn-QA evolution 高 15.4 分。
papers.summary_en: SkillEvo turns multi-turn user simulation into a renewable feedback source for improving agent skills and constrains revisions with governance against factual and structural degradation.
papers.innovation_en: It emphasizes feedback quality and governance rather than merely increasing edit iterations.
papers.metrics_en: Across production cloud-service skills, it exceeds self-reflection evolution by 23.0 points and single-turn QA evolution by 15.4 points.

papers.title: Chain-of-Experience for Continual LLM Improvement
papers.authors: Haoqin Tu, Yunhao Fang, Yizhong Wang, Cihang Xie, Shen Yan
papers.summary_zh: CoE 研究 LLM 在测试时通过迭代经验和反馈持续改进的能力。它比较无反馈、自反馈、执行器反馈、正确性反馈等机制，并显示反馈型 CoE 比常见 test-time 策略更高效。对达人治理自动化巡检、策略推理和申诉处理 Agent 有启发，但不是垂直电商论文。
papers.story_zh: 传统推理把每次问题当成孤立事件，经验不会沉淀；CoE 把多轮反馈轨迹保留下来指导后续解题，形成测试时持续改进闭环。
papers.innovation_zh: 它系统化了 inference-time experience 的概念和反馈类型，工程上可作为治理 Agent 的在线学习范式参考。
papers.metrics_zh: 实验报告 CoE 带来 5.6% 总体提升并降低 19% API 成本，自反馈相对部分 test-time scaling baseline 平均提升约 7–9%。
papers.summary_en: CoE studies how LLMs improve through iterative test-time experience with self, executor, and correctness feedback. It is useful as a design pattern for governance agents that learn from repeated review cases.
papers.innovation_en: It formalizes experience accumulation as a reusable test-time loop rather than one-off self-refinement.
papers.metrics_en: Reported results show 5.6% overall improvement with 19% lower API cost across tasks and models.
